[[Wei Qi]] crafts [[prestige armor]] for [[Factions]] [[profession]]s using the ascended [[Exotic armor]] art. All armor is crafted with an empty [[insignia slot]]. Fellow armorers [[Koumei]] and [[Maiya]] are found next to Wei Qi.

== Location ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Divine Path}}

== Dialogue ==
{{Armorer dialogue}}

If your [[character]] is not an [[Assassin]] nor [[Ritualist]] primary: 
:''"When [[Emperor Kisu]]'s call went out for the finest armor crafters in the land to come here and reward the saviors of [[Cantha]], I expected to find only [[Assassin]]s and [[Ritualist]]s. I can see I was wrong. You are a true hero.''
:''That said, I have not the skills to help one such as you. I recommend you speak with Koumei, who can craft armor truly worthy of your abilities."''
